get.summary: List patient allergies and adverse reactions by filters
get.description: Returns a paginated list of allergies, intolerances and adverse reactions for a given patient, including precautions/safety flags. The patientId is provided as a path parameter; the classification, confirmationStatus and severity filters are optional. Default page=1, size=50 (maximum size 50). Only released records (DT_LIBERACAO not null) are returned.

parameters.name: patientId
parameters.description:
Identifier of the patient whose allergies/adverse reactions will be listed.

**Referenced Table:** PACIENTE_ALERGIA

**Referenced Column:** CD_PESSOA_FISICA

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Defines the current page of the paginated response (starts at 1)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Sets the maximum number of results per page (default: 50)

parameters.name: ignorePaginationLimit
parameters.description: When true, bypasses the endpoint's maximum page size limit (default: false)

parameters.name: classification
parameters.description:
Filters by allergy classification.

**Referenced Table:** PACIENTE_ALERGIA

**Referenced Column:** IE_CLASSIFICACAO

**Possible values:** `ALLERGY`, `INTOLERANCE`, `ADVERSE_REACTION`

parameters.name: confirmationStatus
parameters.description:
Filters by clinical confirmation status.

**Referenced Table:** PACIENTE_ALERGIA

**Referenced Column:** IE_CONFIRMACAO

**Possible values:** `CONFIRMED`, `DOUBT_RAISED`, `ERRONEOUS`, `INACTIVE`, `PENDING`, `SUSPECT`, `UNCONFIRMED`

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description:
Filters by allergy severity/intensity.

**Referenced Table:** PACIENTE_ALERGIA

**Referenced Column:** IE_INTENSIDADE

**Possible values:** `MILD`, `MODERATE`, `SEVERE`, `UNKNOWN`

Empty result.description: Returned when the patient exists but has no allergy records matching the given filters
